query: 'SELECT
    CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), f.fecha_completa, 112) AS INT) AS fecha_key,
    f.fecha_completa,
    CAST(YEAR(f.fecha_completa) AS SMALLINT) AS anio,
    CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER, f.fecha_completa) AS TINYINT) AS trimestre,
    CONCAT('T', DATEPART(QUARTER, f.fecha_completa)) AS trimestre_nombre,
    CAST(MONTH(f.fecha_completa) AS TINYINT) AS mes,

    CASE MONTH(f.fecha_completa)
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Enero'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Febrero'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Marzo'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Abril'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Mayo'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Junio'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Julio'
        WHEN 8 THEN 'Agosto'
        WHEN 9 THEN 'Septiembre'
        WHEN 10 THEN 'Octubre'
        WHEN 11 THEN 'Noviembre'
        WHEN 12 THEN 'Diciembre'
    END AS mes_nombre,

    CASE MONTH(f.fecha_completa)
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Ene'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Feb'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Mar'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Abr'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'May'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Jun'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Jul'
        WHEN 8 THEN 'Ago'
        WHEN 9 THEN 'Sep'
        WHEN 10 THEN 'Oct'
        WHEN 11 THEN 'Nov'
        WHEN 12 THEN 'Dic'
    END AS mes_corto,

    CAST(DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, f.fecha_completa) AS TINYINT) AS semana_anio,
    CAST(DAY(f.fecha_completa) AS TINYINT) AS dia_mes,
    CAST(d.dia_semana AS TINYINT) AS dia_semana,

    CASE d.dia_semana
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Lunes'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Martes'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Miercoles'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Jueves'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Viernes'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Sabado'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Domingo'
    END AS dia_nombre,

    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN d.dia_semana IN (6, 7) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS BIT
    ) AS es_fin_de_semana

FROM (
    SELECT admission_date AS fecha_completa
    FROM silver.admissions
    WHERE admission_date IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT discharge_date
    FROM silver.admissions
    WHERE discharge_date IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT payment_date
    FROM silver.billing
    WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL
) AS f

CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT
        ((DATEDIFF(DAY, '19000101', f.fecha_completa) % 7 + 7) % 7) + 1
        AS dia_semana
) AS d',
